hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Clanker token pools that applies directional static LP fees (configurable per-pool for buying vs. selling the Clanker token), collects protocol fees by modifying swap deltas via beforeSwapReturnsDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta, and supports optional MEV modules (temporary high-fee anti-sniping) and pool extensions during the swap lifecycle.
